text: ぼくは　やっぱり　べんきょうの　ほうが　あってる

structure.jp: べんきょうの　ほうが

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.span: べんきょうの　ほうが
patterns.explanation: の ほうが picks one of two things as the one that is more so. べんきょうの ほうが あってる = 'studying suits me better'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a lasting state; here it is shortened to てる as in casual speech. あってる = 'it suits me'.
